name: add_thesis
description: Save the user's investment thesis so podcast evidence can later be connected to it. A savable thesis states a specific, checkable view: what will happen, why, and roughly by when (e.g. 'AWS data center capex will keep accelerating through 2028 because AI demand outstrips capacity'). If the user only states a stance ('I'm bullish on AMZN'), help them formulate it first: briefly ask what specifically underpins the conviction (which business or driver, what outcome, what timeframe), then save it once they answer. If the thesis is already specific, save it immediately without further questions. Save the user's view in their own terms; do not add claims they did not make. Tag the companies, people, technologies, and concepts it is about; reuse an entity's existing name and kind when it is already in the entities table (check with postgres_database_query). After saving, tell the user what was saved.

description.description: The thesis as one or two clear sentences.

entities.description: What the thesis is about, e.g. [{"name": "Amazon", "kind": "company"}, {"name": "AWS", "kind": "company"}].
